dedupe_keys.name: implan input output economic impact modelling

description: IMPLAN is a commercial input-output modelling application with its own economic data, used to estimate how a change in spending, investment, policy or industry activity ripples through jobs, labour income, economic output and taxes across industries and regions. It offers economic impact analysis, multi-regional input-output (MRIO) analysis, environmental and emissions impacts, a data library, an API and a forward linkages add-on. It is produced by IMPLAN Group, based in Huntersville, North Carolina. Coverage is the United States and Canada, with a global product listed, and use cases include natural disasters, climate risk modelling, tariffs, site selection and data centres; a 2022 webinar showed its use for regional economic losses from hurricanes, forest fires and earthquakes and for recovery. The model runs as a cloud application; prices are given on request and demonstrations are offered. Caveats: input-output models assume fixed production relationships and no supply constraints, so they can overstate ripple effects of short shocks, and the data are proprietary. For simulation it estimates indirect and induced economic losses when infrastructure outages or disasters stop industries in a region, a common step in resilience and investment appraisals. It is related to the BEA RIMS II and adaptive regional input-output records in this catalogue.
